audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes Illaoi's tentacle field as if it appears wherever she stands, and the full layer is untouched template that calls her 'him' in five places.
audit.why: Riot's Prophet of an Elder God text: Illaoi and her Vessels 'spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain'. Tentacles need a wall. Where you stand in the lane therefore decides how many she gets — that is the actual lane-difficulty lever and neither layer said it.
audit.corrected: The terrain rule written into the early and mid text, the wants list, the level-3 spike and the full layer's cooldown and interaction blocks; pronouns fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says Leap of Faith 'spawns a ring of tentacles' without saying what sets the size, and no cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120/95/70 and spawns one Tentacle per enemy champion hit — in a 1v1 that is one extra tentacle, in a teamfight up to five. That difference is the whole reason you flag Hero's Entrance elsewhere rather than contest her 6 in lane.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike and whys[4] now state one tentacle per champion hit and the 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson never appears as a gap-closer, only as a healing source, and no cooldown is attached to anything in the matchup — the packet flags this page as having zero cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a flat 4-second cooldown that also makes every nearby Tentacle swing at the target. Illaoi re-engages every four seconds inside her own field, which is why 'kite out after the taunt' does not work here and why Test of Spirit's 16s is the only cooldown worth timing your commit around.
audit.corrected: Flat 4s Harsh Lesson and 16s Test of Spirit written into the cooldown block, the do's and don'ts, trading rules, Key Ability Interactions and the mid text.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' named neither the source nor the timing, despite _missing-interactions.json flagging this matchup for anti-heal.
audit.why: Two heal sources: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever a Tentacle damages a champion, and Harsh Lesson makes tentacles swing on demand every 4s. The heal scales with how many tentacles are up, so the Orb timing is 'before she has three', not 'when she looks healthy'.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names the tentacle heal and ties the Orb to her tentacle count.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Test of Spirit' appears seven times with no number, and the don't says her E 'catches you mid-dash'.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 at 900 range. Nothing in Riot's text supports it interrupting a dash — it rips a spirit and slows. The real mistake is punching into the tentacle spread at all, because Harsh Lesson brings her back onto you 4 seconds later.
audit.corrected: 16s attached to every mention; the mid-dash claim replaced with the tentacle-spread rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states what actually happens after Test of Spirit lands.
audit.why: Riot: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' Both outcomes make you a Vessel, so 'kill your spirit' is not an escape — the only thing that helps is leaving tentacle range so nothing hits the spirit at all.
audit.corrected: Written into the mid text as 'walk out of tentacle range, do not fight the spirit'.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely yours — she has only a slow Q Tentacle Smash and zero tentacles on the map, so walk up, eat one Q, and shove so she misses last-hits under tower before her passive starts banking tentacles off the terrain. The moment she stacks them (by Level 3 she'll have two or three) the lane flips: your Q Winds of War tornado still pokes her, but every banked tentacle means a trade drags your ripped vessel through a wall of slams. Never throw your E Justice Punch into her spread to start a fight — you'll dash into three tentacles and her sustain.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely yours — she has only a slow Tentacle Smash and zero tentacles on the map, so walk up, eat one Q, and shove so she misses last-hits under tower. Her passive only spawns tentacles on impassable terrain, so where you stand decides how many she banks: hold the middle of the lane and stay off the walls. By level 3 she will have two or three, and the lane flips — Winds of War still pokes, but every banked tentacle means a trade drags your ripped vessel through a wall of slams. Never open with Justice Punch into her spread; you dash into three tentacles and her sustain.

edits.before: By Levels 4-6 she owns the lane. Your W Shield of Durand is built to eat magic — its reduction is heavily amplified against magic damage, but Illaoi's tentacle slams are physical, so W only gives you its weaker base reduction here and can't W-taunt you out of a committed Test of Spirit. Dodging E is everything: sidestep it or body-block it on a minion, because a landed rip lets her tentacles slam your vessel and refund her HP through Harsh Lesson empowered hits. At 6 her R Leap of Faith drops a ring of tentacles your shield can't fully soak — so use YOUR 6, Hero's Entrance, to flag to other lanes instead of contesting hers.
edits.after: By levels 4-6 she owns the lane. Shield of Durand is built to eat magic — heavily amplified against it — but tentacle slams are physical, so W gives only its weaker base reduction here. Dodging Test of Spirit (16s) is everything, and if it does land, do not fight your spirit: walk out of tentacle range, because the spirit echoes a share of every hit it takes back onto you. Do not plan to kite her out either — Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a flat 4s cooldown that also makes every nearby tentacle swing. At 6 her Leap of Faith adds a tentacle per champion hit, so flag Hero's Entrance to another lane instead of contesting hers.

notes: The best fact this page was missing: Prophet of an Elder God spawns tentacles only on nearby IMPASSABLE TERRAIN, so standing in the middle of the lane instead of against a wall directly reduces how many tentacles she gets. Second: Harsh Lesson is a flat 4-second leap that also makes every nearby tentacle swing, which is why 'taunt then walk out' does not work — the packet flagged this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice at all, and 4s vs her 16s Test of Spirit is the sequencing. TWO THINGS I DELIBERATELY DID NOT WRITE. (1) The existing line wants.you[2] says to 'body-block E Test of Spirit on a minion'. Nothing in Riot's text says the spirit rip collides with minions, and minionBlock is null (unknown) in the kit file, so I left that string untouched and listed it as unverified rather than repeat or delete it. (2) _missing-interactions.json claims 'Illaoi can go untargetable through your commit (Leap of Faith (R))' off derived untargetable and grounding flags; Riot's Leap of Faith description mentions neither — it only smashes, damages, and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — so per the kit-file rule I trusted the description and did not write an untargetability claim. Both flags look like tooltip-parse misfires.
